segments.name: Deal seekers
segments.description: Order fairly regularly but with small baskets, and use a coupon on most orders. Mostly in the app.
segments.suggested_action: Targeted coupons on bigger baskets (e.g. 'save ₹100 on orders above ₹800') and bundle offers to raise basket size.

segments.name: Regular shoppers
segments.description: Steady, recent customers who order around every few weeks across several categories.
segments.suggested_action: Grow the relationship: personalised recommendations, subscriptions for staples, cross-sell new categories.

segments.name: Lapsed customers
segments.description: Ordered a few times but have not come back for many months. At risk of being lost.
segments.suggested_action: Win-back campaign: 'we miss you' message with a time-limited offer; ask for feedback on why they stopped.

segments.name: Loyal big spenders
segments.description: Shop very often, recently, with large baskets across almost every category. Rarely need coupons.
segments.suggested_action: Reward and retain: VIP/loyalty tier, early access to new products, free delivery. Avoid unnecessary discounts.

segments.name: Occasional web shoppers
segments.description: Order rarely, almost always on the website, from few categories, with medium-to-large baskets and few coupons.
segments.suggested_action: Push the app (first app-order discount) and remind them about categories they have not tried yet.
